messages:
mira: quick summary from tonight
mira: ran the funcall contract fuzzer against int4-v2 with batch=4, 1.2k samples, ~9% produced parseable-but-wrong args, ~10% outright JSON syntax errors
jon: high level: is this quant-specific or batching-specific?
mira: both correlates. FP16 baseline had ~0.5% errors in same harness
anya: examples?
mira: pasted a couple of representative fuzzer outputs:

```
fuzzer-bot: sample_0021.json
{"tool":"set_pref","args":{"user":42,"prefs":{"theme":"dark"},}}
```

```
fuzzer-bot: sample_0147.json
{"tool":"notify","args":{"user":99,"msg":"hi"}
}
```

mira: two common classes: trailing commas and split-brace sequences across stream chunks
kevin: trailing commas smell like token-boundary misalignment. Quant changes tokenization density -> commas may be emitted as separate subtokens and get fractured by our stream chunker
jon: how does retry actor make it worse?
mira: runtime retry currently replays last N tokens when upstream acks fail; if original emission was truncated across a chunk boundary, replay duplicates suffix fragments -> duplicate keys or extra punctuation
anya: do we have repro with telemetry traces?
ci-bot: telemetry snapshot attached: funcall.parse_errors spike + retry_count median increased from 0 to 1 during canary run window
anya: mitigation ideas?
kevin: short term: add an invisible sentinel prefix so the model is forced to emit a clean JSON token boundary, and runtime strips the sentinel before returning payload. Do canary only for int4-v2 and batch>1
mira: quick experiment: sentinel "<<JSON>>\n" inserted before body dropped syntax errors by ~70% on 200-sample test
jon: customer risk? the runtime stripping must be exact for those using raw outputs. We should gate through dev flag and sticky canary
anya: longer term: sanitize outputs server-side: remove trailing commas, balance braces, and run a fast NDJSON-lint pass. If sanitizer mutates, emit a metric and forward original to storage for audit
kevin: also add a post-assembly atomic check in stream reassembly: if chunk boundary splits a JSON token, prefer waiting for next token rather than immediate flush when latency budget allows
mira: action items: (1) open INF ticket with corpus link and repro steps, attach fuzzer samples (2) kevin to implement sentinel canary + reassembly guard (3) anya to add sanitizer + telemetry for sanitizer_mutations (4) mira to run a 10k-sample overnight fuzz and report
jon: assign: kevin (runtime), anya (sanitizer/validator), mira (fuzz rerun & ticket owner)
ci-bot: ticket INF-6427 created: "quant-canary-stream-suffix-fuzzing-json-reassembly"
fuzzer-bot: corpus uploaded to s3://redwood-fuzz/int4-v2/4312345678/ 1.2k samples
anya: one more ask: add a dry-run option on sanitizer so we can see mutation counts without changing payload delivery
kevin: will include dry-run toggle in canary config
mira: scheduling 30m triage tomorrow 10:00 PT to review canary results
jon: thanks team :thumbsup:
